summary: Patent Watch Admin Feature - Full E2E Testing Complete. All 33 backend tests pass (18 unit + 15 API integration). Frontend UI testing verified all features: setup banner, query CRUD, refresh with missing_api_key error, delete with confirm. Existing admin tabs (Users, Shadow) still work.
critical_code_review_comments: patent_watch_service.py: Clean implementation with proper _strip_id() to exclude MongoDB _id from responses
patent_watch_service.py: Graceful error handling - missing_api_key short-circuits before HTTP call
patent_watch.py routes: Proper admin role check via _require_admin()
PatentWatchPanel.jsx: All required data-testids present (patent-watch-setup-banner, patent-watch-label-input, etc.)
AdminPanel.jsx: Patent Watch tab correctly added to Insights group with data-testid='admin-tab-patents'
route_registry.py: patent_watch_router properly registered and DB wired
seed_data_creation: None - test queries created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patent Watch feature fully tested. Backend: GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/patents/queries, POST /api/admin/patents/refresh/{id}, GET /api/admin/patents/results, GET /api/admin/patents/config all working. Frontend: AdminPanel has 'Patent Watch' tab in Insights group, PatentWatchPanel shows setup banner when USPTO_API_KEY not configured, query CRUD works, refresh shows error toast for missing_api_key. USPTO_API_KEY is intentionally not set - this is expected behavior.

backend_endpoints.GET /api/admin/patents/queries: Returns 200 with {queries:[]} when authed as admin, 401 without auth
backend_endpoints.POST /api/admin/patents/queries: Creates query, strips _id, returns all expected fields
backend_endpoints.GET /api/admin/patents/config: Returns {api_key_configured:false, api_base_url, setup_url} - never leaks key

frontend_ui.setup_banner: data-testid='patent-watch-setup-banner' visible when no API key - PASS
frontend_ui.add_query_form: All inputs have data-testids (label, assignee, inventor, keyword, create-btn) - PASS
frontend_ui.regression: Users and Shadow tabs still work - PASS

mocked_apis.note: USPTO ODP fetch is NOT mocked. Refresh endpoint short-circuits with error='missing_api_key' before any HTTP call since USPTO_API_KEY is not configured. This is the expected graceful path being tested.
